ModMetaData.name: ForkSave (experimental)
ModMetaData.author: nezor
ModMetaData.description:
Factorio-style non-blocking autosaves for the native Linux build: the game fork()s and the child process writes the autosave while you keep playing.
Experimental. If the background save fails or exceeds the timeout, the child is killed and a normal blocking autosave runs instead. Other platforms, and Commitment mode, keep the vanilla autosave.
